title: Todd Hundley 1990 Upper Deck - #726 (RC)
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 1990 Upper Deck trading card features Todd Hundley, the rookie player for the New York Mets. The card is part of the base set and has a card number of 726. It is in near mint or better condition and showcases Hundley in his Mets uniform. 

The card is perfect for collectors of baseball sports trading cards, especially those who collect cards from Major League Baseball (MLB). The 1990 Upper Deck set is highly sought after by collectors and this card is a must-have for any fan of Hundley or the Mets. Add this rare and valuable card to your collection today.
